d:
Serbia and Germany delivered a DRAMATIC finish at EuroBasket 2015!
Playing in front of their home crowd in Berlin, Germany pushed Serbia to the limit in an intense battle that came down to the FINAL seconds. With the score tied at 66-66 and the pressure at its highest, Serbia needed one last clutch play!
That's when Nemanja Bjelica stepped up! He knocked down a decisive floater with less than a second remaining to give Serbia a thrilling 68-66 victory and silence the home crowd!
